scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @queuelab/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @queuelab/storage build && pnpm --filter @queuelab/database build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n api,worker,web -c cyan,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:api" "pnpm dev:worker" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.db:seed: pnpm --filter @queuelab/shared-types build && pnpm --filter @queuelab/storage build && pnpm --filter @queuelab/database seed
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @queuelab/shared-types exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @queuelab/storage exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @queuelab/database exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter @queuelab/api exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && pnpm --filter @queuelab/worker exec tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @queuelab/shared-types test && pnpm --filter @queuelab/storage test && pnpm --filter @queuelab/worker test && pnpm --filter @queuelab/api test
